features.quote: Max **30 steps**. (DeepSeek-R1 CoT is cheap at DeepSeek prices; 30 steps keeps mean cost ~$0.60/run.)

If the exact same `tool_calls` payload is emitted **5 times consecutively**, the harness injects: `[HARNESS] You have executed identical actions 5 times. Consider an alternative strategy.` and forces termination at step 30 regardless.
